sources.title: Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011 — Appendix A: List of Food Additives (revised 30-12-2011)
sources.publisher: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
sources.notes: Fetched and read 2026-08-04. Appendix A lists additives BY NAME across 15 food-product tables, each with a per-product limit. It contains NO INS numbers, so every INS-to-name mapping in ins.json is our inference and is recorded in each evidence entry as entryName. Only Tables 1 (bread and biscuits) and 2 (snacks/savouries and related) were examined; Tables 3-15 were not, so UNKNOWN never means prohibited.
